items.title: crm
items.description: An open-source, agentic-first CRM.
items.summary: An agentic-first CRM is an open-source tool designed for autonomous AI collaboration in managing customer relationships. It emphasizes AI-driven automation while allowing human oversight. It is built to enhance data handling and streamline sales workflows.

items.title: kimi-k3-in-c
items.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
items.summary: Kimi K3, a 2.78-trillion-parameter model, runs inference on a single CPU with 8.24 GB RAM using a portable C99 engine without any BLAS, framework, or GPU. It streams experts from NVMe, activating only 16 out of 896. Output remains consistent regardless of available RAM.

items.title: genoffice
items.description: An AI-native office suite for macOS and Windows: word processor, spreadsheet, presentations, and PDF.
items.summary: GenOffice is an AI-native office suite for macOS and Windows, featuring a word processor, spreadsheet, presentation editor, and PDF tool. It is open-source and free, with signed installers available.

items.title: anatomy
items.description: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer built using threejs with GPT 5.6 Sol
items.summary: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer was built using threejs and GPT 5.6 Sol. It's available on GitHub and praised for its educational value. I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon.

items.title: human-writing
items.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
items.summary: AI-written text can be refined to sound more human by removing AI characteristics and adding personal touch. Tools like "說人話.skill" and "Humanizer" help achieve this. These skills focus on making text more specific, honest, and like a real person's writing.

items.title: RealReplicaBench
items.description: RealReplicaBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Agents in High-Fidelity, Stateful, and Reproducible Replicas of Real Online Services
items.summary: RealReplicaBench is a benchmark for long-horizon agents in high-fidelity replicas of real online services. It evaluates agents on complex commerce and business workflows. The latest version is v1.3.1.

items.title: open-kimi-ppt-skill
items.description: 非官方 Kimi Slides Skill：让 AI Agent 生成可编辑 PPTD + PPTX，并附带本地浏览器编辑器 Unofficial Kimi Slides skill for AI agents — generate editable PPTD + PPTX with a local browser editor
items.summary: The unofficial Kimi Slides skill allows AI agents to generate editable PPTD and PPTX files with a local browser editor. This skill is not officially supported but offers useful features for presentation creation.

items.title: humanizer-cli
items.description: 33 ways to spot AI-written text, right in your terminal. Before/after examples, draft checker, zero dependencies.
items.summary: An AI system built by a team at Amazon offers tools to detect AI-written text and humanize content. It includes features like before/after examples and real-time monitoring. It requires no dependencies.

items.title: finger-frame-effect-ai
items.summary: The finger-frame effect uses AI to generate a real-time animated world inside a finger-framed video. It can restyle recorded videos with AI. A Gemini API key is required for the AI restyle.

items.title: doc7
items.description: Turn documents into AI-ready Markdown with visual understanding
items.summary: Markdown offers clear, structured content for AI, improving embeddings and reducing errors. It preserves document hierarchy and formatting, enhancing AI understanding. Markdown's simplicity aids in accurate data retrieval.

items.title: awesome-free-ai-course-notes
items.description: A curated collection of machine learning and AI lecture notes from the world's leading universities.  This repository gives you access to the same lecture notes used by students at top institutions such as MIT, helping you learn from the very best educational resources available.
items.summary: The best free AI courses include Elements of AI, AI for Everyone, and MIT 6.S191. These courses offer comprehensive, beginner-friendly introductions to AI.

items.title: ratchet
items.description: Your agent reads the rules. This checks whether it followed them.
items.summary: Ratchet refers to a pattern ensuring tasks are completed sequentially without regression, using deterministic verification. It prevents agents from prematurely declaring completion. It's used in coding to ensure thoroughness.

items.title: awesome-growth-hacking-skills
items.description: Find agentic growth hacking skills for Claude, ChatGPT, Manus | by enso.bot
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. Agentic growth hacking involves AI agents executing go-to-market tasks at speed and scale. This approach aims to replace fragmented growth operations with a unified agentic layer.

items.title: super-simple-software-factory
items.description: Repeatable agents-plus-code workflows, packaged as one skill, stamped into any repo. Deterministic Python owns the graph; coding agents are bounded nodes inside it.
items.summary: Super-simple-software-factory is a deterministic Python-based tool for creating repeatable coding agents. It packages workflows as skills and uses coding agents as bounded nodes in a graph. It's available on GitHub.

items.title: HermesOffice
items.description: HermesOffice — AI-native office suite forked from GenOffice (Apache-2.0), with native Hermes Agent AI
items.summary: HermesOffice is an open-source office suite built on GenOffice, featuring a local AI agent. Hermes Agent is an autonomous AI agent that runs locally and evolves over time. Both are separate projects with different focuses.

items.title: time-to-first-token
items.description: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for LLM inference serving and optimization. vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, benchmarking.
items.summary: vLLM and SGLang optimize LLM inference; quantization and speculative decoding further reduce time-to-first-token. Benchmarking shows vLLM excels in throughput, while SGLang minimizes decode latency.

items.title: qiaomu-seo
items.description: Audit, diagnose, research, plan, implement, experiment on, and verify website SEO across Google, Bing, and AI-search surfaces. Use for technical SEO,
items.summary: Qiaomu Miao is involved in technical SEO and has connections with major tech companies. Another Hu Qiaomu was a dissenting academic who left China for the US in 2017. They are different individuals.

items.title: Fuxi
items.description: FuXi is a fast, self-contained AI developer terminal
items.summary: Fuxi is a self-contained AI development terminal that requires no runtime or setup. It offers a rich terminal user interface and integrates multiple large language models. It is free and available as a single static binary.

items.title: agent-vision-toolkit
items.description: 给纯文本 LLM agent 装上眼睛：图片问答、OCR、截图分析、视觉定位等一套视觉工具箱 + skill，并可无缝接入 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi ｜ Give text-only LLM agents vision: image Q&A, OCR, screenshot understanding, visual grounding, image-to-SVG - a vision toolkit & skill, with drop-in integration for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi
items.summary: The agent-vision-toolkit provides vision capabilities for text-only LLMs, including image Q&A, OCR, and visual grounding, with integration for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi. It enhances LLMs' abilities through external APIs and skills.

items.title: LongHorizon-Harness
items.description: The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows. Features fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, recoverable progress, and native Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw integration.
items.summary: LongHorizon-Harness runs AI agents across desktop apps and CLI, preserving task state and progress. It features independent auditing and integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It maintains verified progress even after context refreshes.

items.title: toolknit-desktop
items.description: 多功能工具箱 · 桌面端开源版 | 音视频/图片/PDF/AI 一站式处理
items.summary: Toolknit Desktop is an open-source, multi-functional toolset for offline processing of PDFs, images, audio/video, AI, and text. It processes files locally, ensuring privacy. It is free and cross-platform.

items.title: InduSecAgent
items.summary: InduSecAgent None refers to governance features in Nudge Security's managed agents, including scoped permissions and risk insights. Bezuclastinib is a drug for systemic mastocytosis targeting KIT D816V mutation. Cogent Biosciences submitted a new drug application for Bezuclastinib.

items.title: databricks-ai-bootcamp-capstone
items.summary: The Databricks AI Boot Camp capstone requires a data pipeline in Spark, third-party API integration, unstructured data processing, a Databricks App, and an AI agent. Submissions after August 9th will not be certified or eligible for rewards.

items.title: diri
items.description: Native macOS orchestrator for coding agents — run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and shells in parallel across git worktrees and remote hosts
items.summary: DiRi is a native macOS orchestrator for running multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini in parallel across git worktrees and remote hosts. It provides isolated environments and streamlined interfaces. It supports cross-platform use.

items.title: DeterminFlow
items.description: A production-oriented AI workflow runtime for building, validating, recovering, and shipping complex AI workflows as dependable services. 面向生产的 AI 工作流运行时：快速开发、验证和恢复复杂 AI 工作流，并将其稳定交付为服务。
items.summary: DeterminFlow is a production-oriented AI workflow runtime for dependable AI service delivery, emphasizing deterministic validation, observability, and fast rollbacks. It supports multi-agent orchestration and enforces security at the skill boundary.

items.title: reflection-engine
items.description: A downloadable prompt that turns your AI assistant's memory of you into a candid, evidence-grounded portrait.
items.summary: A reflection-engine is a tool that uses AI to create personalized insights based on past interactions. It's designed for self-reflection and not for professional advice. It requires memory and detailed prompts for best results.

items.title: mcpx
items.description: MCPX 是运行在开发环境中的 MCP Runtime（网关）。ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor、Grok 及其他支持 Streamable HTTP 的 MCP 客户端，可以通过统一工具面理解项目、查看 Unified Diff、修改源码、运行任务、采集环境信息，并调用本地 MCP 与 Skill。
items.summary: MCPX is an Amazon-built runtime for AI agents. It enables unified tool access and governance. It supports streamable HTTP for client interactions.

items.title: hbg-classical-poem-silk-video
items.description: Agent Skill for turning Chinese classical poems into vertical Chinese-art videos with ImageGen stills, Docker I2V, calligraphy captions, retained ambience, BGM and final MP4 QA.
items.summary: AI transforms Chinese classical poems into vertical art videos with stills, Docker I2V, calligraphy, and music. Models generate drafts, polished versions, and integrate visual elements. Final output is an MP4 with retained ambiance.

items.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit
items.summary: JoyAI-Echo is an advanced open-source AI model generating 5-minute long videos with consistent audio and character identity. It's notable for its cross-modal memory and long-form video capabilities. Released in 2026, it's a significant project for video generation.

items.title: phoenix
items.description: 不死鸟 Phoenix — Hermes Agent 插件：路由分档/风险防线/自愈/存档点提醒/审批策略自适应，官方钩子接入，不改 Hermes 核心代码

Hermes Agent supports switching between various large language models and integrates with multiple platforms for messaging. Hermes plugins can be added without modifying the core code.

items.title: dscode
items.description: Coding agent powered by DeepSeek.

items.title: Qwen-CUA
items.description: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (Almost) Everything — a screenshot-driven agent that operates computers with keyboard and mouse, jointly developed by the Qwen Team and XLang Lab.

items.title: bindwidth
items.description: Evidence-aware on-prem LLM inference sizing and TCO calculator
items.summary: Memory bandwidth is crucial for on-prem LLM inference sizing. Use cost calculators for detailed TCO analysis. Benchmarks show AMD and NVIDIA GPUs for optimal performance.

It supports Windows and offers features like screen capture, window management, and clipboard operations. The latest version includes advanced security detection capabilities.
